title: The Captor's Deal
text: A bandit chief holds the Lost in a ring of stakes, ropes at their throats. He is in no hurry. He offers a trade, as one reasonable person to another: one of yours for one of them. He does not much care which.

options.label: Trade the toughest, who might break free later and find their way back.

outcomes.text: The chief takes them. In the night they break their ropes, returning bloody but whole.
The chief is no fool. He was counting on you trying something, and so were his men.

options.label: Draw steel, ropes or no ropes. No one bargains with your people's lives.

outcomes.text: The bandits are many. They fight like people with nothing left to lose.

options.label: Pay him in gold instead of flesh, and hope his greed outweighs his cruelty.

outcomes.text: Gold does the talking. The ropes come off while the chief counts every coin twice.
